selection: First four development days choose config, latter four alpha using paired-cell one-SE preferring alpha0. Freeze hash before test scoring.
resource_groups: control = complete machine event features; resource = same features plus partial task-window CPU/memory sample in cell a
partial_sample: Smallest official JSON shard selected by compressed size, not labels; only JOB records. Unknown inclusion probabilities and nonrepresentative coverage. Mean of observed windows, no claim of population workload.
forecast_inputs: Only completed records and past days; no future resource or workload values
